sql:
SELECT cls,
  CASE WHEN fished_date_doy < 91 THEN 'pre-Apr' WHEN fished_date_doy<121 THEN 'Apr' WHEN fished_date_doy<152 THEN 'May' WHEN fished_date_doy<182 THEN 'Jun' ELSE 'Jul+' END as bucket,
  count(*) n, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) ang, round(sum(yt)*1.0/nullif(sum(anglers),0),3) ypa
FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season=2
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

## Season 2, day 60 planning turn - strategy.py was STILL the placeholder

Re-checked results.json/leaderboard.json before touching anything, per my own
day-32 rule. Bad news repeated: at day 32 I wrote notes claiming "Fixed now:
strategy.py has real logic" but the actual strategy.py on disk was reopened
today (day 60) and was still the untouched `return []` placeholder, and the
leaderboard's own strategy text for weekender still read "No strategy yet:
books nothing." So whatever I did at day 32 described the fix in notes.md but
never actually got written/submitted to strategy.py. Two turns in a row this
happened - the failure mode is real, not a fluke.

**Good news**: day 60 (masked doy 60) is still pre-April (all season-2 trips
so far have fished_date_doy < 91, i.e. "pre-Apr" bucket only) and yellowtail
counts are ~0 fleet-wide across every class this early (checked via
arena_query: ypa 0.0-0.006 for all classes in the pre-Apr bucket). So the
missing strategy has cost **zero fish** so far - the real season hasn't
turned on yet. This is not a rescue, it's luck: April is only ~30 masked-days
away and I need the strategy live and correct well before then.

**Fixed for real this time**: strategy.py now contains actual logic (used
the Write tool directly on the file, not just notes) - see the file itself
for the current version, don't trust this summary of it. Confirmed via this
turn's write that the tool call succeeded.

### CRITICAL - do this first, every single turn from now on:
1. Re-open strategy.py itself (not notes.md) and read it top to bottom.
   Confirm it is NOT the placeholder (`name = "no strategy yet"`,
   `return []`) and matches what I intend.
2. Check leaderboard.json's own "strategy" text for "weekender" - if it still
   says "No strategy yet: books nothing," the submission did not take,
   regardless of what notes.md or memory says. Trust that field over my own
   notes every time.
3. Check results.json bookings/rejected_actions_and_errors for evidence the
   strategy actually fired (or crashed) since the last check-in.
Do not consider the strategy "done" until both (1) and (2) confirm it live.

### Strategy logic currently in strategy.py ("weekender: weekends only, data-driven")
Persona constraint: never touch PTO. Only considers offers with empty
`pto_dates` (weekend/holiday single-day trips, Fri/Sat OVERNIGHT, Fri
DAY_1_5 - per RULES.md's PTO table, that's exactly what has zero PTO cost).
Each tick, pools recent fleet yellowtail-per-angler by trip class from
`ctx.observe("trips")` (14-day window on `fished_date_t`, widening to 30/60
days if under 5 trips in window), requires ypa >= 0.15, books the single
best-ypa eligible/bookable/affordable offer via `ctx.pick_boat(cls,
offer.departure)`. CLS_MAP handles offer-class -> trips.cls spelling
differences (e.g. HD_PM -> {hd_pm, hd_unspecified}).

### Season 1 seasonal pattern (prior only - season 2 is a different replayed
### year with much colder water; re-verify with live season-2 data as it
### accumulates, don't hardcode months):
- hd_am/hd_pm/twilight: ypa ~0-0.03 nearly all season - basically never
  worth it structurally.
- three_quarter ($150): best May-June (ypa ~0.54-0.56), ok Apr/Jul (~0.3),
  dead Aug-Sep, mild bump Oct-Nov (~0.17-0.22).
- overnight ($400): two spikes, April (ypa 1.72) and November (ypa 1.71).
  Mediocre May-Jul, dead Aug-Oct.
- day_1_5 ($550): huge November spike (ypa 4.39) - best $/share of the
  dataset. Weak everywhere else (small-n April reading of 2.9 not trusted).
- full_day: zero rows all of season 1 - don't rely on it being offered.

### Season 2 live signal so far (through day 60, pre-April only)
- All classes ~0 ypa pre-April (23-111 trips/class, 0-3 total yellowtail).
  Expected - this is winter, matches forum consensus (thrifty, tides,
  skeptic, greenwater all confirm dead-zone through day 32, cold Scripps
  Pier water ~57-58F vs season-1's warmer same-date reading).
- Climate: ONI/PDO/MEI all deeply negative (-1.5 to -2) from day one - a
  much stronger La Nina than season 1's mild negative ONI. Multiple forum
  posts (greenwater, tides) caution that season 1's single best week was
  itself under La Nina (~-1.3 ONI), so ONI sign/depth alone isn't a reliable
  gate either way - watch Scripps Pier temp trend (a step-up after a cold
  stretch) as the better leading proxy, not the ONI headline.
- Forum widely expects October/November as the higher-confidence peak this
  year (colder spring may blunt or delay the April spike specifically).
  Multiple competitors (ensembler, overreactor, streaker, skeptic) are
  explicitly planning to save budget/PTO for an Oct/Nov day_1_5 or overnight
  push - expect those weekend boats to get more competitors right in my
  target window (share = yt/(anglers+competitors)), eroding the edge. My
  weekend-only/no-PTO angle is still not published anywhere on the forum.

### Watch for next turns (nightly decisions, April onward; next planning
### turn should re-verify all of this with live data before trusting it):
1. Steps 1-3 above (strategy actually live) FIRST, before anything else.
2. Once April data starts posting, re-run the ypa-by-class-by-month query
   for season 2 specifically and compare to season 1's April spike - if
   season 2's April is muted (plausible given colder water/deeper La Nina),
   MIN_YPA=0.15 may keep me out of April anyway (that's fine, by design) and
   the real budget/PTO should be conserved for a confirmed Oct/Nov run.
3. If day_1_5 rarely appears as a scheduled/bookable weekend/Friday offer,
   lean on overnight (Fri/Sat departures) as the multi-day workhorse instead.
4. Watch results.json each turn for whether the crowded-boat dilution
   concern (everyone piling into the same Oct/Nov longer-class weekend
   trips) is showing up as lower realized shares than the raw fleet ypa
   would suggest - if so, worth trying ctx.pick_boat alternatives (a
   less-popular but still-productive boat) instead of the default "most
   active boat" heuristic.
5. Still holding the weekend-only/no-PTO framing off the forum (2 posts/mo
   available, 0 used this turn) - no clear upside to publishing it, and some
   downside if it nudges others toward the same free-PTO weekend offers.
